What the best products do, drawn on our surfaces. Three researchers read 72 patterns from command-first, ops-and-finance and AI-native products; an adversary judged 96 rows against the eight house rules (51 keep · 40 adapt · 5 reject) and named three things all of them missed. These sixteen survived. None is built; four of them are forks (F8–F11).

overlays.name: Peek beside the list
overlays.title: Öküzgözü 2022 · Kavaklıdere
body: Space opens it beside the ledger; ↑ ↓ step rows; Enter promotes it to the sheet; Esc closes. No scrim, no focus trap — the list stays live.
overlays.footer: Non-modal. Never a form, never the seal.
overlays.why: For the 80% of glance-then-move-on lookups, a sheet is too much and a hover card too little. It is not a fourth shape: it has no scrim and traps nothing — the non-modal class ADR 0112's carve-out allows, named (fork F8).
overlays.source: Linear — Peek (https://linear.app/docs/peek) · adversary A1: ADAPT, name it non-modal

overlays.name: The palette with pages and one argument
overlays.title: Command palette
body: ↵ opens the approval panel with the seal; ⌫ or Esc steps back a page. One argument, never a form.
overlays.footer: ↑↓ · ↵ · ⌫ back · esc
overlays.why: One command box drills into a picker instead of a long tail of small popovers. The adversary's cap: a command that wants three arguments is a disguised form and belongs in a panel or a sheet.
overlays.source: Raycast arguments (https://developers.raycast.com/information/lifecycle/arguments) · cmdk pages (https://dip-cmdk.mintlify.app/guides/nested-items) · adversary A3 KEEP, A4 ADAPT (cap at one argument)

overlays.name: A hover card on a referenced name
overlays.title: Kavaklıdere
overlays.why: Hovering substitutes for navigating: the reader confirms 'is this the right one' without leaving the row. Non-modal, dismissed by moving; its own menu is open/copy-link only, never a form.
overlays.source: GitHub hovercards (https://github.blog/changelog/2018-10-08-issue-and-pull-request-hovercards/) · Notion hover preview · adversary A15/A16 KEEP

overlays.name: Undo after, for what can be undone
overlays.title: Entry dismissed — 'Öküzgözü is below par'
overlays.why: Fire the routine act, offer the way back — instead of a panel before it. Scoped hard: dismissals, archives, a removed shift, a note. Never money, never a send, never a ledger row: those keep the seal before (fork F10).
overlays.source: Linear undo (https://linear.app/changelog/undo-actions) · Sonner (https://sonner.emilkowal.ski/toast) · adversary A6/D5: ADAPT — reversible, non-money, non-send only

overlays.name: Approve, then release
overlays.title: Release ₺ 12,000 to Kavaklıdere?
body: INV-4471 · matches the order line by line
overlays.footer: Two moments, two seals: approving the order and releasing the money are never one hold (ADR 0110, 0125).
overlays.why: Ramp separates chain approval from the payer's release; the house already lists them as separate commitments. Drawn so the second seal is seen, not assumed.
overlays.source: Ramp Bill Pay approvals (https://support.ramp.com/bill-pay-approvals) · adversary B16 KEEP, verified

overlays.name: Why this was flagged, on the row
overlays.title: Order 121 · Sevilen · held
body: ₺ 260 per bottle is 11% above the agreed ₺ 234 — the house stops an order 10% over its agreement (ADR 0116). Vendor terms, written 2 Sept by Ayşe.
overlays.why: Every figure names its rows; every flag names the rule it tripped, on the object itself — never in a separate log the approver has to go and find.

overlays.name: Select many, one plain bar
overlays.title: 4 selected
body: x toggles · ⇧ ranges · ⌘A all · Esc clears
overlays.why: Bulk gets the plain die: a bar at the bottom, no scrim, no seal. The house rule already says so; this is only the mechanic.
overlays.source: Linear select issues (https://linear.app/docs/select-issues) · adversary A17/B21 KEEP — adopt the fuller keyboard spec

overlays.name: A manager's passcode at the point of action
overlays.title: Correct the case count to 4?
body: The manager's name is written on the line; the seal is theirs, not the staff member's.
overlays.why: The restaurant industry's own second-authority ceremony: superior authority, completed in seconds at the point of action — not a multi-step chain. A different thing from a two-person rule; the founder should choose which acts get which (fork F11).
overlays.source: Toast POS discounts — manager passcode prompt (https://support.toasttab.com/en/article/Basic-Discount-Configuration) · adversary §6: MISSED by all four files

overlays.name: Suggested edits, not applied edits
overlays.title: The engine suggests two changes
body: Tue · Thu · Sat — three Saturday deliveries since June
A suggestion is a layer on the record, never an already-changed cell. The person's words stay ink; the engine's stay grey — permanently, not only until accepted.
overlays.why: The best structural proof that 'a draft never looks sent' is buildable: nothing is touched until a person disposes of each suggestion. Provenance is a colour that never fades.
overlays.source: Notion suggested edits (https://www.notion.com/help/suggested-edits) · Granola black/grey (https://www.granola.ai/blog/how-to-use-ai-to-take-meeting-notes) · adversary C9 KEEP (verified), C16 KEEP

overlays.name: Ask about this, with its sources
overlays.title: Ask about this order
body: Did we pay more than last time?
Yes — ₺ 2,400 per case against ₺ 2,250 on 24 July [1], the same unit [2]. The three orders before that were ₺ 2,250 too [3].
When the book holds no line, the answer says so: 'The book holds no line about freight for this vendor.'
overlays.why: Every sentence cites a row or says 'no data'. Sources stream with the answer, not after it — an absence is reported as an absence.
overlays.source: Grounded Q&A scoped to one object (adversary C10 KEEP) · Perplexity streaming citations (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/cookbook/articles/streaming-citations/README) · C15 KEEP

overlays.name: A proposal you accept line by line, sealed once
overlays.title: Three changes to the house's configuration
body: Each line has its reason and its provenance; you accept or reject each, then one hold applies what stands.
overlays.why: Three granularities of accept are right; a plain 'Accept all' button is wrong when the apply is a real commitment. The ticks choose, the seal commits (ADR 0113).
overlays.source: GitHub Copilot Edits per-hunk accept (https://learn.microsoft.com/visualstudio/ide/copilot-edits) · adversary C1 ADAPT — the batch resolves to one seal

overlays.name: The door's sheet rests at three heights
overlays.title: How many boxes?
body: Peek shows the next step; half holds the count; full holds the photo. The grabber appears only because there is more than one height.
overlays.why: On a phone the right sheet becomes a bottom sheet — same object, same head, same close-in-words — resting at detents instead of a fixed 440. Four files asked for this four ways; it is one decision (fork F9).
overlays.source: Apple HIG sheets and detents · Material bottom sheets (https://m2.material.io/components/sheets-bottom/android) · Vaul snap points (https://www.npmjs.com/package/vaul/v/1.0.0) · adversary C18/C19/D1: ADAPT — ONE decision

overlays.name: Swipe up to record it; the stamp at the end
overlays.title: Record this delivery
overlays.why: The founder's own ask, proven at scale in a high-stakes app: review, then one deliberate gesture; the house's stamp completes it. On desktop the same act is the hold.
overlays.source: Robinhood swipe-up-to-submit (https://robinhood.com/us/en/support/articles/selling-a-stock/) — swipe confirmed, haptic detail dropped by the adversary (C20 ADAPT)

overlays.name: Queued is never confirmed
overlays.title: Delivery · Kavaklıdere · 14:06
body: A record made with no signal looks provisional and steps forward through named states; it never silently reads as recorded.
overlays.why: The right vocabulary for the door: four states, each unmistakable. An absence (no signal) is reported as what it is.
overlays.source: WhatsApp offline queue and tick ladder · adversary C24 KEEP

overlays.name: Who else has this open
overlays.title: Öküzgözü 2022
body: Elif is counting rack B on her phone · started 14:01
Two people may count at once; the sheet says so, so neither writes over the other unknowing.
overlays.why: Concurrency is not the failure mode — invisibility is. A presence line on shared records makes a split count safe (fork F11).
overlays.source: Figma presence and multiplayer (https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040449713) · adversary §6: MISSED — answers B's own concurrent-count gap

overlays.name: The invoice beside the order, cell by cell
overlays.title: Order 118 · Kavaklıdere
body: The paper stays visible while you correct the read; a mismatched cell is marked on the cell, not in a message.
overlays.why: Both cited products do this in place, not in a popup — the founder's own 'side-by-side inside an overlay' ask is answered by rule 6: the row expands and shows its working.
overlays.source: Ramp PO matching · Restaurant365 discrepancy view · Toast AI invoice scanning split view (https://support.toasttab.com/en/article/Get-Started-With-AI-Invoice-Scanning) · adversary B17/B-R2 KEEP

overlays.name: Step up before the money moves
overlays.title: Your session is three hours old
body: Before ₺ 12,000 leaves the house, say who you are again. The hold is intent; this is identity.
overlays.footer: Only before money or a config apply, and only when the session is older than two hours.
overlays.why: A device left unlocked is the common failure; re-authentication at the moment of a real commitment closes it without touching routine work.
overlays.source: GitHub sudo mode (https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/sudo-mode) — fetched, holds: two hours; password, passkey or 2FA · G: ADAPT

overlays.name: What the seal bound
overlays.title: Released ₺ 12,000 to Kavaklıdere
body: Ayşe · owner — one approval suffices (the authority rule)
The challenge minted when the hold began carries the amount and the payee; a receipt that does not match them is not a seal (ADR 0112, 0125).
overlays.why: The provable seal made visible: what was bound, by whom, and the link to the record before it. Verifiable after the fact, not asserted.
overlays.source: FIDO Secure Payment Confirmation (https://fidoalliance.org/white-paper-secure-payment-confirmation/) — fetched, holds: amount and payee signed by the authenticator (PSD2 dynamic linking) · AWS CloudTrail digest chain (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-log-file-validation-intro.html) · G: KEEP

overlays.name: A new bank detail waits
overlays.title: Kavaklıdere's bank detail changed today
body: a letter from orders@kavaklidere… · 11:02 · read by the house
The first payment to the new detail waits 24 hours and is released by someone with valid authority who is not the confirmer. Every owner has been told of the change.
Call the number on file — +90 312 000 00 00 — not the number in the letter.
I called; hold to confirm the detail
overlays.why: Vendor-impersonation is the single highest-fraud act on the list; a rare ceremony is worth it precisely because it is rare. The house's own separation of duties in one line.
overlays.source: City National Bank dual control and call-back (https://www.cnb.com/business-banking/insights/what-is-dual-approval.html) · UK Finance Confirmation of Payee (https://www.ukfinance.org.uk/policy-and-guidance/guidance/confirmation-payee) · G: ADAPT — bank-detail changes only, never every new vendor

overlays.name: Held for a look
overlays.title: Payment 3 of today · Sevilen · ₺ 3,600
body: Third payment to Sevilen today, four times its usual ₺ 900 — outside this house's own pattern of the last 90 days. A manager's day limit is ₺ 5,000 (ADR 0128).
overlays.why: A velocity check adds nothing to the common case and names its reason on the row when it trips — the house's rule for flags, applied to money.
overlays.source: Stripe Radar rules and review (https://docs.stripe.com/radar/rules) · Ramp limits (https://support.ramp.com/hc/en-us/articles/10881975647763-Card-limits-and-spend-programs) · G: KEEP, silent on the common case

overlays.name: The door tablet locks itself
overlays.title: Locked after 90 seconds
body: Whoever picks this up is not Elif until they say so. Her count is saved on this device and waits for her.
overlays.why: A shared device left open hands every person's authority to whoever picks it up; an idle lock is what makes the passcode ceremony mean anything.
overlays.source: Toast POS screen timeout (https://support.toasttab.com/en/article/Adjust-POS-Screen-Timeout) · Square passcodes at the point of sale (https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/8357-require-passcodes-at-point-of-sale) · G: KEEP — the precondition for the manager's passcode

overlays.name: Break the glass
overlays.title: Bypass the two-person rule for this payment?
body: Hasan is unreachable and the delivery is on the truck.
Every owner is told the moment you hold. The trail marks this release in red and it cannot be made routine.
overlays.why: Emergency access exists in every serious system; the house's version is owner-only, written down, and loud — never a quiet backdoor.
overlays.source: AWS Well-Architected break-glass procedures (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/devops-guidance/ag.sad.5-implement-break-glass-procedures.md) · G: ADAPT — rare, reasoned, told to everyone

forks.title: Ratify the three shapes.
forks.text: ADR 0112 is still Proposed. Everything drawn here assumes Sheet · Panel · Popover; if the founder wants one shape everywhere, this census is the list of what that costs (the sheet exists so the list stays readable; an anchored menu with no anchor has lost its meaning).

forks.title: The studio invite.
forks.text: Reuse the one exception component (Popover modal) with a second opener — my recommendation: one component, however many openers, is still one exception — or collapse the policy to two modal shapes as the ADR's revisit clause says.

forks.title: A delivery without an order.
forks.text: A 640 sheet on /inventory (drawn), or a route under /receipts where the receipts desk already lives.

forks.title: Acts no house surface recreates.
forks.text: Pause AI on a thread · a person-authored one-tap action or quick-action bookmark · an auction purchase · certifications on file · assign a recommendation to a person. One call per act: delete, or build the drawn shape.

forks.title: Where a manual order starts.
forks.text: The owed 'A new order' sheet on /orders, or from a register row, the palette, or Ask AI — OrdersNext has no create path today.

forks.title: Two bells, two user menus.
forks.text: Header.tsx's house branch and HouseHeader's HouseBell/HouseUserMenu both exist. Which survives when the house header lands on every page.

forks.title: The figure behind a dashboard number.
forks.text: A sheet ('the working', drawn) or the house idiom — the KPI row expands in place.

forks.title: The non-modal class.
forks.text: Name peek · hover card · undo toast · bulk bar · the standard bottom sheet as what they are: not shapes (no scrim, no focus trap, never a form, never the seal). ADR 0112's own carve-out allows them; four files asked for them four ways — one amendment, or none.

forks.title: The sheet on a phone.
forks.text: A bottom sheet with detents (peek / half / full) as the right sheet's phone form, and sheet stacking capped at three with a breadcrumb — one decision covering Apple detents, Material sheets and Vaul snap points together.

forks.title: Undo after, for what can be undone.
forks.text: Fire the routine act and offer Undo (dismiss, archive, a removed shift, a note); keep the seal before for money, sends and ledger rows. The adversary's fight #4: the line must be written down or it creeps.

forks.title: A second authority.
forks.text: Two ceremonies the research surfaced that the house has not chosen between: a manager's passcode at the point of action (Toast) for staff → manager acts, and presence on shared records (Figma) so a split count is safe. Which acts get which.

forks.title: The consent step has no home.
forks.text: Built 2026-09-06 as a Panel, asserted not sealed — and unreachable. Its only opener is ServicesPermissions.tsx:300, mounted solely by the LEGACY settings page (pages/Settings.tsx:1262); the rebuilt page's ServicesSection renders the same four consents as records with NO switches, because nothing in any of the four runtimes branches on them and ADR 0020 forbids a control whose effect does not exist. Either something reads a consent and the rebuilt page gets a real control back, or this act is a deletion. Not a builder's call.

forks.title: Every other security ceremony like that.
forks.text: The founder's addendum to F11. Twenty-four ceremonies catalogued (research/F), judged by the lead (research/G: 3 rejected — a retired ledger product, JIT sessions for staff, an out-of-band call per payment), six drawn above, and a fit per act proposed below. Decided act by act, not as a set.
